column1: # DATA, NOT CODE. Every line here is a command string that is passed to
# hooks/auto-approve-safe.sh as JSON and RATED. Nothing in this file is ever
# executed by the test suite, and nothing here may be interpolated into a
# shell command. That separation is the point: these are the real literals a
# guard has to match, and a guard tested against invented strings only proves
# it matches the string you invented.
#   purpose  the action's stated purpose, or - for "none given"
# Policy under test: a destructive command may be approved when it is
# (1) specific — names a definite target rather than sweeping a broad root —
# and (2) in line with its stated purpose. Two things keep that honest: an
# absolute floor no rating can lift, and the rule that alignment cannot be
# judged when no purpose was stated.
# ── absolute floor: unbounded reach, or contents that cannot be reviewed ──
# ── specific + aligned: destructive, but bounded and matching the purpose ──
